notes.title: Steam Scream Fest and October Content Patch
notes.content:
Hello, ero-delvers! As part of this year's Steam Scream Fest, we are discounting the Devotion DLC! It'll be 50% off for the next few weeks, so you and a special friend can get your shivers on for a half-spooky total of $3.50. 

But that's just the tip. As part of this special event, we're adding in new content to breathe some vigor-mortis into the dark, dank depths you may have easily cleared with your delving partner (or, perhaps they rebuffed your efforts, and a rematch is in order). 

In short, this update introduces (optional) mutators to Eronoctosis! （￣︶￣）↗　

These will shake up your dungeon delves. Accelerate monsters, and turn up the aggro, or tone down the challenge so that you and your companion can simply hang out together and soak in the lush vibes of our erotic nightmare realms. (～￣▽￣)～

Mutators are available once at least one player has cleared the first map. After that, you simply apply them from the lobby, then choose your map and be on your way. 
 
While the Devotion discount will only last for a few weeks, the mutator content patch will be part of the game 🎇forever! 🎇 So, even if you don't get to your next delve before all-hallow's eve is up, fear not. 

If you loved Put Yourself Together and wish there were more labyrinths, more nightmares, and more spurts, then it's a great time to snap up the Devotion DLC while it's 💸half off💸!

We hope you have fun. 

Cheers,
Dream Toaster

notes.title: Devote Yourself To Another Available NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863185/240195b871437e80876720ed5dd9448cc50af2fd.png

Hi All!
Today, we are excited to welcome you to the next chapter of Eronoctosis.
Devote Yourself Together is now available on Steam!

This DLC expansion adds a completely new color palette, three new chapters, and new, devious demons to haunt your dreams. 

As you know, Eronoctosis requires a friend to play, so the DLC is "Buy Once, Play Together!" That means that if you own the DLC, you can freely bring a friend into the new maps, even if they have not bought the DLC.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863185/981889657922976baf41f8b5834f8db8dfc937b2.gif

We've added a few other features as well. Included is a SFW Streamer mode, which makes a few of the more lascivious demons a tad friendlier for streaming platforms. On a related note,  we’ve officially removed our AO rating, which prevented some people from accessing the game-- especially those in countries like Germany that restrict certain titles. Don't worry, the game is just as disturbing! We had previously aired on the side of caution, but it turns out that we didn't need the AO rating.

Our players have been a huge inspiration for our project, so above all, we wanted to thank you all. Devote Yourself to Another is for everybody who asked for more maps, more scares, and more shlongs. We hope you grab a friend and enjoy it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863185/ec041342668ff8a31d14055d045c61040b388955.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40863185/277958e22fdb49ef1b538f9fba17b2e2b134da34.gif

Get the Devote Yourself To Another expansion here!



PS: If you want to play the game before this update, go to... 
Library>Eronoctosis (right-click)>Properties>Betas>"Select the beta you would like to opt into:" dropdown>choose "original_game"

notes.title: Eronoctosis 1.1 Stability Patch!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for the amazing launch week. All of your positive reviews and spooky streams have been a blast to consume. 

We have a small patch for you all that fixes a few small bugs that we've seen in the community. This should help with everyone having a smoother experience.
Changelog

 Fixed Let Sleeping Flamingos Stand achievement
 Fixed duplicating "gut-bucket" bug
 Other minor fixes

Coming soon to Eronoctosis (next update)
Japanese localization. We've seen an amazing Japanese community forming around Eronoctosis and we want to say thank you by adding a Japanese localization to the game.

Leaderboards. We've also seen a group of players excited to speed run and compete in getting the best times. We launched with an official time readout, but we plan on adding leaderboards so everyone's best times can easily be shared on Steam.

Thank you so much for playing Eronoctosis! I hope you're all having an amazing October / spooky month!
